title: Godrej Properties — Risk & Reputation Research
content:
According to ComplaintsBoard, Godrej Properties has unresolved complaints regarding flat possession delays and unresponsive staff. Trustpilot reviews from October 5, 2026, highlight poor customer service and unresolved issues, with one reviewer stating they would give zero stars if possible. Godrejvanantara mentions mixed reviews, noting that while property investors appreciate good rental returns, buyers often complain about strict payment deadlines and extra costs like Land Under Construction fees. The sources do not provide a definitive answer.

The sources indicate that Godrej Properties has been involved in several legal disputes. One such dispute is a civil suit filed by Anita Yadav against Godrej Properties regarding the applicable GST rate for her residential unit purchase, where she argues that the builder wrongly charged 12% GST instead of the reduced 5% rate. Another dispute involved Godrej Properties and Orris Infrastructure over the Godrej Air housing project in Gurugram, which was resolved amicably, leading to the quashing of pending FIRs. Additionally, the Supreme Court of India ruled on a case involving earnest money forfeiture in real estate contracts between Godrej Projects Development Limited and buyers, highlighting the Court's stance on refunding payments made by buyers upon cancellation of apartment bookings.

The plaintiff Anita Yadav filed a civil suit against Godrej Properties Ltd regarding the applicable GST rate for her residential unit purchase. She argues that the builder wrongly charged 12% GST instead of the reduced 5% rate as per the February 2019 GST Council meeting. She has repeatedly asked Godrej to revise the rate but they have refused. The plaintiff seeks a court declaration that the 12% rate is invalid and the builder must return the excess amount charged with interest and penalties. [...] and penalties. She alleges the builder intentionally misled her and violated tax laws to unlawfully profit at her expense.
